project.job: Tacolneston, NR16 1BY - 15 plots (6 detached, 2 semi pairs, a terrace of three, 3 bungalows)
project.model_title: ES26-092 Tacolneston, NR16 1BY - 15 plots (6 detached, 2 semi pairs, a terrace of three, 3 bungalows) - Quotation

views.title: Plot 1 (4-bed detached)
views.desc: Plot 1 - 4-bed detached, rooms in the roof, with the single-storey open-plan extension + store: 328 Nudura 6.6in XR35 forms, stack joints (red) where the runs are off the Nudura Bond. ICF from the foundation (2 courses below ground) to the 4,050 eaves and up the gables to the 7,921 ridge. Steels (preliminary) over the 5.32 m bi-fold, the side doors and the first floor transfer over the open plan. Slab, first floor, vaulted cut roof (rafters on ridge beams, no ceiling ties) with the dormers and windows as design assumptions.

views.title: Plots 2 + 3 (semi-detached pair)
views.desc: Plots 2 + 3 - semi-detached pair, two storey, ICF party wall: 331 Nudura 6.6in XR35 forms, stack joints (red) where the runs are off the Nudura Bond. ICF from the foundation (2 courses below ground) to the 4,950 eaves and up the gables to the 9,353 ridge. Slab, first floor, trussed roof and windows as design assumptions.
